Scholarship overview

This RMIT scholarship supports research into quantum cluster capacitors for thin-film energy storage. The advert is relevant to chemistry, materials science, applied physics and nanotechnology preparation. An additional top-up is negotiable and should not be treated as guaranteed funding.

Research Areas

  • Nanotechnology
  • Materials science
  • Energy storage
